decision.reason: Pinned LocalLLM introduces per-request random seed and requires a concrete locally available OpenAI-compatible model/server. Free availability and hardware fitness are execution-environment facts, not source-code facts.

required_before_model_freeze: concrete locally available model identifier and immutable revision/digest
execution server identity/version and model artifact provenance
deterministic seed strategy or explicitly versioned adapter removing per-request random seed
evidence that the selected local execution environment incurs USD 0 provider spend
